title: Q1A - Add consentful discovery and relationship data contracts
objective: Implement versioned Pod-authoritative discovery, relationship, moderation, receipt, and replay contracts plus layout and manager foundations without enabling user-facing behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Contracts and fixtures cover explicit public fields, schema versions, immutable activity IDs, expiry, provenance, and private moderation state.
Pod layout includes public discovery, append-only inbox, private relationships, private moderation, and replay resources with least-privilege ACL tests.
Unknown RDF triples survive round trips and conditional-write conflict behavior is tested.
Legacy foaf:knows migration is documented as legacy-connected without inferred acceptance or public consent.
Focused solid-pod-sync lint, type-check, and tests pass.

title: Q1B - Build secure WebID and LDN integration boundary
objective: Design and implement standards-compatible WebID, Type Index, and LDN adapters with session-bound owned-Pod operations and a credential-free SSRF-resistant external discovery/delivery path.
acceptanceCriteria: NodeZero bearer credentials are never sent to external origins and tests prove the boundary.
External fetch rejects non-HTTPS, loopback/private/metadata targets, unsafe redirects, DNS rebinding, oversized responses, unsupported media types, and timeouts.
WebID inbox and public Type Index links are discovered from RDF and supported HTTP Link headers.
LDN delivery uses bounded payloads, explicit recipient targets, and no full ActivityPub claim.
Focused provisioner and solid-pod-sync checks pass.

title: Q1C - Define consent and delivery security test vectors
objective: Produce executable security and privacy acceptance vectors for append-only inboxes, external fetch, replay, sender verification, migration, indexing, H3 linkability, block precedence, and rollback.
acceptanceCriteria: Test vectors classify release-stop failures for credential leakage, SSRF, public inbox reads, spoofing, replay, inferred consent, private indexing, and block bypass.
Public field minimization and telemetry/evidence redaction requirements are explicit.
Vectors map to concrete package tests and Milestone Q UAT rows.
A security handoff is posted to SOLID_DATA_AGENT, SOLID_INTEGRATION_SPECIALIST, P2P_RELAY_AGENT, and QA_RELEASE_AGENT.
evidence: policy:validate-consentful-discovery PASS: 22 vectors across 10 categories; Solid 168, mobile 90, provisioner 101; strict staging PWA artifact PASS; AUDIT_AGENT local GO; no deployment performed.

title: Q4D - Design the consentful discovery QA program
objective: Translate the ADR and Milestone Q UAT rows into package, integration, zero-retry browser, physical-device, deployment, rollback, and soak test specifications before implementation completes.
acceptanceCriteria: Two-account test matrix covers default-off, own mutation, cross-user denial, opt-out, relationship transitions, block precedence, location without presence, reveal, DMs, recipients, restart, and rollback.
Identity-only auth evidence remains separate from consentful discovery evidence.
Artifact privacy rules exclude credentials, tokens, private interests, blocks, H3/reveal history, and message content.
The proposed qa:smoke:consentful-discovery contract and required environment inputs are documented.
